author: Craig Jones
title: 'Halftime Report' Picks For January 8: Amarin, Apple And More | Benzinga
text:
Related AMRN 22 Stocks Moving In Monday's Pre-Market Session 20 Stocks Moving In Wednesday's Pre-Market Session Amarin And The Art Of Low-Balling Guidance - Why 2019 Forecast Are Too Low (Seeking Alpha) Related Some Believe Emerging Markets Are Beckoning Video: Why It Might Be Time To Buy Beaten-Down Emerging Market ETFs Marketplace Authors' Top Picks For 2019 (Seeking Alpha) On CNBC's "Fast Money Halftime Report" , Jon Najarian said he likes Amarin Corporation plc (NASDAQ: AMRN ).
Rob Sechan thinks ISHARES INC/CORE MSCI EMERGING (NYSE: IEMG ) is inexpensive.
Jim Lebenthal is a buyer of weakness in Roku Inc (NASDAQ: ROKU ).
Stephanie Link likes Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE: OXY ). She said it yields 4.7 percent and it can support its dividend with crude oil at $50.
Joe Terranova is a buyer of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ).
